## Current continuation — owned triangles and uniform three-root completion reductions, October 29, 2026 UTC

The unrestricted sharp theorem, equality classification and global prerequisite audit remain **OPEN**. Original inventories are unchanged: **2373/2513** fine flags checked (**140 open**), **36/58** coarse rows closed (**22 open**).

Six new complete mathematical sources and their six full independent reviews are adopted in ADOPTION_OWNED_TRIANGLES_AND_THREE_NEAR_COMPLETION_REDUCTIONS_2026_10_29.md, with exact identities and inventories in OWNED_TRIANGLES_AND_THREE_NEAR_COMPLETION_REDUCTIONS_CHECKPOINT_2026_10_29.json. Root read every complete new source and every complete independent report.

**Unique physical circle corner:** the full three-type port classification and complete Type-I free-interface join now give an actual side owner on **each of AV, DV and AD**. The fourth finite dense family is imposed together with the preceding three before extraction, inside the same explicitly assumed prior nonempty OPEN admissible domain. All old nondense restrictions and genuine matched parameters remain. The owned triangle geometry and global prior compatibility audit remain open.

**Two physical circle corners:** all five original applications are now proved distinct, and the entire one-free/one-shared roof feature is excluded by a selection-free support proof, including every shift, full mean interval and individual-zero circle endpoint. The two exact inner-face charts retain their remaining singleton/owned alternatives. Both D02 rows keep the full unloaded A3/D3 stars, loaded V2/B2/C2, N unloaded in L135 and loaded in L1345, and all three actual completion squares.

**Uniform three-root capacity:** THREE_REAL_S_LEAF_ROOTS_WITH_TWO_EPSILON_VERTICES_NINE_UNIT_EXCLUSION_2026_10_29.md (SHA256 3eca9443f10f1bb6b3ccb46f5fad25f64951fa0dd8c1fe87e0aed62d2de8931e) proves total capacity at most eight whenever each of three actual real-S roots has a vertex within 2epsilon. Every root degree and all nine physical units remain. A surviving high three-root feature therefore has some root with no vertex in D_(2epsilon); the older two-4epsilon-vertex result does not supply the excluded premise.

Its complete companion THREE_NEAR_UNITS_COMPLETION_CENTER_COMPONENT_ARCS_AND_REAL_S_LEAF_BUDGET_2026_10_29.md (SHA256 fdc1a41c0f405782b2b4f901d45a3c05a6aa56bc9529ea50a48e5a7f14faf9fa) gives an actual-circle component and gap budget at arbitrary root degrees. At least two of the three other units beyond the chosen roots and leaves occupy components longer than forty degrees, and the third exceeds acos(9/10). The proof retains disconnected full intersections and every actual leaf face.

The complete simple-C5 three-leaf feature remains closed. House ADT/ADB/ABC, fan H12/H23 and the other original parent obligations remain with their exact residual domains. No original fine or coarse flag changes. The complete previous PR description is preserved in PR11_DESCRIPTION_ARCHIVE_AT_875DA3F_2026_10_29.json before its current summary is shortened.
